checks.q: Is the voting power snapshot taken before proposal creation to prevent flash loan attacks?
Is the timelock delay sufficient to allow response to malicious proposals?
Are quorum requirements set appropriately to prevent minority takeover?
Is the proposal execution function protected against reentrancy?
Are vote delegation and undelegation properly time-bounded?
Is the governance token's transfer restricted during active voting?
Are treasury spending proposals properly bounded?
Is the proposal creation threshold set to prevent spam?
Are emergency proposals handled with appropriate security checks?
Is the voting period long enough for all stakeholders to participate?
Are defeated proposals properly prevented from re-execution?
